Loading indicator built on the shared 3-dot animation. `centered` fills the space it is given (`h-full` within a `min-h-32` floor) and establishes a size container (`container-type: size`) so the default `responsive` size scales the dots to that space via `cqmin` — small inside a narrow/short panel, large on a full-page route shell that stretches it tall. The `inline` variant is not a container, so a `responsive` request there renders at `sm`.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/loading.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { Loading } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/components";
```
